```{r}
# Codon usage: CU, RSCU, CAI w/ seqinr

library(seqinr)

table <- "examples/hs_cai"
fasta <- "examples/example.fasta"
```


```{r}
# Kazusa/hs_cai  (CODON per1000(count))
ln <- readLines(table)
tk <- unlist(regmatches(ln, gregexpr("[ACGT]{3}\\s+[0-9.]+\\([0-9]+\\)", ln)))
n  <- as.numeric(sub(".*\\(([0-9]+)\\).*", "\\1", tk)); names(n) <- tolower(substr(tk, 1, 3))
aa0 <- sapply(names(n), function(c) translate(s2c(c)))
w  <- n; for (x in unique(aa0)) { i <- aa0 == x; w[i] <- n[i] / max(n[i]) }

fa <- read.fasta(fasta)
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fa), function(id) {
  s    <- fa[[id]]
  eff  <- uco(s, index = "eff")
  rscu <- uco(s, index = "rscu")
  aa   <- sapply(names(eff), function(c) translate(s2c(c)))
  data.frame(seq = id, codon = toupper(names(eff)), count = as.integer(eff),
             CU   = round(as.numeric(eff / tapply(eff, aa, sum)[aa]), 4),
             RSCU = round(as.numeric(rscu), 4),
             CAI  = round(cai(s, w = w[names(eff)]), 4))
}))

res
```


```{r}
write.csv(res, "codon_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("OK ->", nrow(res), "codon_metrics_R.csv\n")
```
```{bash}
./coconut -all examples/example.fasta codon_metrics_coconut.csv
```


```{bash}
./coconut -cai examples/hs_cai codon_metrics_coconut_cai.csv examples/example.fasta

```

```{r}
# R seqinr vs Coconut (-all y -cai)

r   <- read.csv("codon_metrics.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cc  <- read.csv("codon_metrics_coconut.csv", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cai <- read.csv("codon_metrics_coconut_cai.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```


```{r}


codons <- sub("_CU$", "", grep("_CU$", names(cc), value = TRUE))
cc_long <- data.frame(
  codon   = codons,
  CU_cc   = as.numeric(cc[1, paste0(codons, "_CU")]),
  RSCU_cc = as.numeric(cc[1, paste0(codons, "_RSCU")]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

m <- merge(r, cc_long, by = "codon")
m$dCU   <- abs(m$CU   - m$CU_cc)
m$dRSCU <- abs(m$RSCU - m$RSCU_cc)

na_codons <- m$codon[is.na(m$dRSCU)]   # NA vs 0

cat(sprintf("CU   : max|Δ| = %.4f\n", max(m$dCU,   na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("RSCU : max|Δ| = %.4f\n", max(m$dRSCU, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("CAI  : R = %.4f | Coconut = %.4f | Δ = %.4f\n",
            r$CAI[1], cai$CAI[1], abs(r$CAI[1] - cai$CAI[1])))

cat("\nWorst 5 / RSCU:\n")
print(head(m[order(-m$dRSCU), c("codon","CU","CU_cc","RSCU","RSCU_cc","dRSCU")], 5),
      row.names = FALSE)
```
